agreements: V5 preserves the intended organism: THINK is live child thought/action/outcome, DREAM is disposable waking context, personal SLEEP writes grounded child-authored experience, and the optional bootstrap is pre-parenting schooling rather than a cognitive organ.

The T/D paired active control, M0 diagnostic, merge-once immutable births, sole response-only writer, fixed exogenous parenting, control-plane repetition, classified retry, and preservation of committed life remain sound prospective commitments.
Model execution, truth scoring, scientific reporting, blindness audit, lineage audit, external human authority, verification, and release must remain distinct one-way stages.
Delta_R, Delta_F, Delta_E, replay, repetition, rank, cadence, blindness, canary, and independent-root claims retain their narrow v5 meanings; v5 supplies no implementation or scientific evidence.
Exact capability, transaction, data, statistical, review, GPU, claim, publication, push, and release contracts require later byte binding and human authority after proposal repair.

disagreements.issue: The graph and replay claims select fresh zero-effective-delta personal adapters from immutable birth, but the exact loop and matrix let the personal writer dereference prior active weights.

positions.position: Prior active weights must be unavailable to personal candidate construction and remain only an E5 preservation comparator.
E4_SLEEP_COMPILER_WRITER reads E4_DEREFERENCE_ACTIVE_WEIGHT_ARTIFACT in addition to immutable birth and eligible evidence.

resolution.rationale: Prior-weight access creates an undeclared continuous-weight, selection, or conditioning path and invalidates replay and cadence interpretation. The project has repeatedly selected fresh-from-birth replacement, so topology is preserved rather than changed implicitly.
resolution.selected_position: Every personal candidate starts only from its immutable assigned birth with a fresh zero-effective-delta adapter; prior active weights are visible only to the preservation evaluator.
resolution.required_change: Remove E4_DEREFERENCE_ACTIVE_WEIGHT_ARTIFACT from the personal writer, its loop reads, and the matrix; add prior-weight mutation-invariance and birth-only initialization checks.

disagreements.issue: V5 claims one-epoch capabilities, yet the same E2-E5 capabilities are visible to consumers in other numbered epochs without a close, attenuation, and reissue edge.

positions.position: Treat immutable artifact lifetime separately from a handle lease and issue fresh read-only or verify-only handles to each later consumer.
One named capability is reused across producer and later consumer epochs while prose still calls every capability single-epoch.

resolution.rationale: Stage prefixes and fresh invocations cannot revoke a copied capability. Exact close-and-reissue attenuation is required to make the lifecycle claim falsifiable.
resolution.selected_position: Persistent immutable artifacts may survive, but every operation handle closes at its epoch boundary and each consumer receives a newly issued, attenuated handle.
resolution.required_change: Add producer-to-consumer close/reissue transitions, separate per-consumer capability IDs, lease validity and revocation semantics, and copied/replayed/stale-handle denial with constant-shape failure; regenerate the complete matrix.

disagreements.issue: BOOTSTRAP_BUILD_AND_BIRTH reads the exact writer and toolchain, but E1_BIRTH_WRITER has no capability for writer, merge, tokenizer, serializer, or toolchain configuration.

positions.position: The birth writer reads only paired corpus and frozen M0; other contract inputs remain ambient or implicit.
A typed frozen bootstrap writer/merge/tokenizer/serializer/toolchain contract needs an explicit source and E1 read capability.

resolution.rationale: Ambient contract state defeats least authority, reproducible birth identity, and matched optimizer opportunity.
resolution.selected_position: Add an explicit frozen E1 bootstrap writer-and-materialization contract capability.
resolution.required_change: Declare the contract object, its producer or exact external source, E1_BIRTH_WRITER read capability, loop read, matrix cells, root binding, and ambient-configuration taint failure.

disagreements.issue: E7/E8 consume dependency manifests, taint receipts, lineage receipts, preservation projections, narrow attestations, and release bindings that lack declared producers or narrowing transitions in the exhaustive graph.

positions.position: The auditor and verifier read-side capabilities are listed without all corresponding producers and transforms.
Every authority-facing object must have one explicit producer or declared external source and a typed attenuation/narrowing edge.

resolution.rationale: An undeclared sidecar would possess authority and information outside the supposedly complete stage-capability product.
resolution.selected_position: Make the audit, attestation, verification, and release-binding graph producer-closed.
resolution.required_change: Declare producers or exact external sources for every E7/E8 readable object, add projection/attestation stages and write or verify-only capabilities, include them in the Cartesian matrix, and prohibit semantic content or reusable upstream authority in narrowed outputs.

disagreements.issue: Release uses TRANSFER_OPAQUE although the registry permits only six other operations, the release loop omits transfer, and root-only binding allows artifact-class or destination substitution.

positions.position: An authority verdict plus exact target root is sufficient for opaque release.
Opaque transfer must be registered and authorization must equality-bind the complete release tuple.

resolution.rationale: Content opacity does not prevent type confusion, destination substitution, replay, or scope widening.
resolution.selected_position: Register TRANSFER_OPAQUE and bind a canonical one-shot release tuple end to end.
resolution.required_change: Define TRANSFER_OPAQUE with no inspection or content-conditioned branching; add it to the loop and matrix; bind artifact root, artifact class, destination, operation, protocol, scope, nonce, expiry, and idempotency key in external authorization, verifier verdict, controller input, and receipt.

disagreements.issue: Tests required before implementation need implemented capability, transaction, treatment, or audit artifacts, while ES21's prose registry does not map every action to all prerequisites.

positions.position: ES19 and ES20 precede implementation and ES21 requires their valid receipts before affected actions.
A test cannot require the guarded domain machinery needed to create itself; a separately scoped model-free harness and machine-readable action DAG are required.

resolution.rationale: An implicit fixture exception is an unregistered authority path, and two generic receipts do not encode source, statistics, tokenizer, birth, exam, GPU, claim, or release ordering.
resolution.selected_position: Define a separately ratified minimal model-free gate-harness bootstrap, then install an exact action-to-prerequisite DAG before any guarded domain action.
resolution.required_change: Split model-free fake-fixture harness work from guarded system work, enumerate every action and prerequisite receipt machine-readably, make the DAG acyclic, require statistics and sources before generation, and prove no protected action is needed to create its own gate receipt.

disagreements.issue: The compiler may render multi-evidence generalized continuations while the thesis says it writes child-authored experience and never invents cognition.

positions.position: Grounded premises can support a compiler-rendered generalized continuation.
Grounding premises does not prove the generalized proposition was child-authored; compiler synthesis would be a separate teacher intervention.

resolution.rationale: The selected thesis assigns discovery credit to the child's lived cognition. Allowing post hoc compiler synthesis changes the parent/compiler causal graph and experiential-memory claim.
resolution.selected_position: Every loss-bearing generalized or corrective proposition must already be child-authored and grounded before compilation; the compiler may not add semantic content.
resolution.required_change: Define clause-level child-authorship, temporal precedence, grounding, and structure-preserving rendering rules; reject compiler-synthesized generalizations even when every premise is grounded, or deliberate any compiler-teacher intervention separately.

disagreements.issue: The systems interpretation treats the named registry as not constructible without exact per-capability bytes; the critique distinguishes graph/lifecycle omissions from permissible deferred implementation constants.

positions.position: Bind schemas, issuers, namespaces, operations, lifecycle, attenuation, constant-shape failures, and denial tests before implementation ratification.
Structural issuer, producer, consumer, operation, and epoch edges are proposal blockers, while canonical wire and transaction bytes may remain separately gated downstream contracts after repair.

resolution.rationale: The structural authority graph must exist in successor proposal bytes, but choosing serializer, authentication, and transaction constants there is not necessary if separately exact contracts precede corresponding implementation.
resolution.selected_position: Require structural capability and lifecycle repair in the successor, then bind remaining wire, transaction, and evaluation constants in separately authorized exact contracts before use.
resolution.required_change: Do not defer the seven topology defects; after repairing them, freeze exact schemas, issuers, attenuation, lease/revocation, constant-shape errors, roots/serialization, transcript/score closure, CAS/fsync/concurrency, retries, quarantine, DREAM cache, and preservation verdict bytes before implementation or execution.

disagreements.issue: V5 fixes causal estimands and qualitative controls but defers the exact generator, rubric, preservation, scoring, inference, replay, and safety bytes needed for execution and claims.

positions.position: These exact constants can remain later separately scoped evidence contracts under the selected architecture.
Deferral is acceptable only if the contracts are frozen before their first relevant generation or execution and cannot be chosen after outcomes.

resolution.rationale: The narrow estimands are architecturally coherent, but margins and named controls alone are not executable or powered evidence.
resolution.selected_position: Retain the narrow estimands and require exact prospective evidence contracts before relevant generation or execution.
resolution.required_change: Freeze sources/splits, overlap and advice rules, computation rubric, M0 difficulty, solo resources, writer factorial, child-authored support, preservation, endpoints, power, intervals, multiplicity, safety comparators, directional controls, replay closure/filler, and cadence analysis in separately authorized packets.

disagreements.issue: Whether a technically detailed rework consensus can authorize repair, implementation, execution, release, or ratification of the rejected v5 bytes.

positions.position: Rework permits successor proposal preparation only; every later scope requires a fresh chain and exact human authority.
Treat consensus-selected repairs as direct authorization to edit or execute the system.

resolution.rationale: Model adjudication cannot ratify, implement, or infer human permission, and a rework recommendation is mechanically non-releasable.
resolution.selected_position: Only successor proposal drafting and fresh deliberation may follow.
resolution.required_change: Keep intake untransitioned and implementation, model/tokenizer, data/benchmark, adapter/checkpoint, GPU/resource, external science, claim, publication/push, release, and ratification actions forbidden.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The E4 prior-weight dereference contradicts immutable-birth zero-delta replacement and permits an undeclared weight-continuous path.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Remove prior active-weight access from candidate construction and prove every personal candidate depends only on immutable birth, eligible evidence, frozen writer contract, and equality-only snapshot binding.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Reused E2-E5 capabilities make copied or stale handle use legal despite the single-epoch claim.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Close each operation handle at epoch end and explicitly mint attenuated per-consumer handles through registered transitions; test revocation, copy, replay, and stale denial.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The exact birth loop depends on writer/materialization bytes absent from E1_BIRTH_WRITER capabilities.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a typed E1 frozen writer/merge/tokenizer/serializer/toolchain contract with explicit producer, read edge, root binding, matrix cells, and ambient-state taint failure.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Authority-facing read objects without producers or narrowing transforms require an undeclared privileged sidecar outside the exhaustive graph.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Producer-close all dependency, taint, lineage, preservation, attestation, and release-binding objects with explicit stages, external sources, attenuation edges, and recomputed matrix cells.

concern_dispositions.rationale: TRANSFER_OPAQUE is unregistered and root-only authorization does not prevent type, destination, protocol, scope, or replay substitution.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Register and loop-bind opaque transfer and equality-bind the full artifact-root/class/destination/operation/protocol/scope/nonce/expiry/idempotency tuple through authorization, verdict, action, and receipt.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Several pre-implementation receipts require the guarded machinery that they purportedly precede, and ES21 omits per-action dependencies beyond ES19/ES20.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Specify a separately ratified model-free fake-fixture harness and an acyclic machine-readable mapping from every affected action to all exact prerequisite receipts and authority.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Grounded premises do not establish that a generalized proposition was authored by the child; compiler synthesis would move cognition and credit into post-training.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Require pre-existing child authorship and grounding for every semantic loss-bearing clause, including corrective and generalized clauses; permit only frozen meaning-preserving rendering.

concern_dispositions.rationale: After structural repair, constructibility still requires exact capability, transaction, evaluation, cache, and verdict bytes before corresponding implementation or use.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind the listed schemas, issuers, attenuation, lifecycle, errors, root encoding, transcript/score closure, CAS/fsync/concurrency, retry, quarantine, DREAM, and preservation contracts under separate human scope.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The selected estimands are not reproducible, powered, or claim-bearing until their exact sources, interventions, analysis, and safety rules are prospectively frozen.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Freeze every listed generator, split, rubric, overlap/advice rule, resource control, writer/support/preservation rule, endpoint, power/inference rule, safety comparator, replay mapping, and cadence analysis before relevant generation or execution.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The interpretations and critique agree that v5 creates no result and that every proposed contrast has only the stated narrow conditional meaning.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Preserve the exact Delta_R, Delta_F, Delta_E, replay, repetition, rank, blindness, cadence, canary, source-fit, extraction, native-use, and independent-root claim limits in every successor and downstream packet.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Seven proposal blockers require successor bytes and a fresh chain; this consensus cannot release any downstream action.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Permit successor proposal preparation only and retain every implementation, execution, science, release, and ratification prohibition.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: It identifies an exact causal-topology contradiction; E4 prior-weight access must be removed under fresh-from-birth replacement.
The same handle cannot be both single-epoch and directly reusable by later consumers; close-and-reissue attenuation is required.
The E1 birth writer otherwise relies on ambient authority for causal and reproducibility-critical configuration.
Opaque transfer is a real authority-bearing operation and must be registered, represented in the loop, and tested.
The current registry is circular for fixture construction and incomplete for later action-specific prerequisites.

Issuer/producer/consumer, attenuation, operation, and lifecycle gaps are proposal blockers; remaining canonical wire, authentication, and transaction bytes may be separately bound after structural repair but before implementation.
Missing E7/E8 producers and narrowing transforms leave an undeclared authority path and must be repaired in proposal bytes.
A separately authorized model-free harness is needed to construct gate receipts without executing guarded domain actions.
Root-only binding cannot constrain artifact class, destination, operation, protocol, scope, freshness, or replay.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: It must use producer-closed attestations, a registered opaque transfer, a complete release tuple, and the noncircular action DAG.
It must cover close/reissue attenuation, the noncircular fixture tier, and clause-level child authorship rather than grounding alone.
It must deny prior-weight access, bind the E1 bootstrap writer/materialization contract, enforce child-authored targets, and run at a constructible DAG tier.
The tiny model-free initializer invariant remains necessary and is unaffected by the seven proposal defects.
The merge invariant remains, but the birth writer must receive and bind an explicit frozen merge/tokenizer/serializer/toolchain contract rather than ambient configuration.
It must use birth-only candidate construction, close/reissue handles, producer-closed receipts, and an acyclic fixture/action ordering.
The paired semantic audit remains, but it must bind the explicit bootstrap writer contract and reject non-child-authored generalized target clauses.
The audit path needs explicit receipt producers/narrowing transforms, the E1 contract closure, and a noncircular birth-dependent audit tier.
The split executor/scorer/reporter Delta_R assay remains correct, subject to later exact evaluation and evidence contracts.
The cursor-only fixed-curriculum package test remains correct, subject to downstream resource, data, and inference contracts.
The adaptive package estimand and split evaluation remain valid under the preserved narrow claim boundary.
It must test per-consumer reissued handles and execute under the noncircular action-prerequisite DAG while preserving cursor-only fixed parenting.
It must enforce birth-only candidate creation and clause-level child authorship before testing storage, extraction, and native use.
Replay dependence requires an explicit prior-weight denial fixture, immutable-birth initialization, and child-authored closure membership.
The compiler-conditional rank-by-exposure assay is unaffected and remains subject to a later exact writer/evidence packet.
The cadence assay must preserve fresh-from-birth candidate topology; prior active weights may be evaluation comparators but not writer inputs.
Its setup already requires pre-generation freezing, but required_before must be represented in the action DAG rather than only as model_execution.
It must regenerate a producer-closed matrix with close/reissue transitions, birth-only SLEEP, registered release, child-authored targets, and a constructible lower fixture tier.
It must use fresh-from-birth candidates, attenuated handles, explicit stale-full-head CAS behavior, and the acyclic harness/domain split.
Review and GPU authority must bind producer-closed attestations and the complete release/run tuple under the exact action DAG.
Replace the prose/two-receipt gate with an acyclic machine-readable action-to-all-prerequisites DAG and separately authorized model-free harness bootstrap.

Will personal SLEEP remain fresh-from-immutable-birth, persistent artifacts cross epochs only through close-and-reissue attenuation, and every loss-bearing generalized proposition require prior child authorship?
